text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much
for giving me the day off yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It's been so long since
I had such a leisurely phone call with Ma...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm totally refreshed,
so I'm ready to give training my all again starting today!
